courses.title: Equine Management Science
courses.description: A study of horse industry emphasizing the importance of breeds, selection, evaluation, nutrition, breeding principles, disease control, equipment, facilities to ensure scientifically based management decisions. Corequisite(s): AVS 1125L .

courses.title: Equine Management Laboratory
courses.description: A study of horse industry emphasizing the importance of breeds, selection, evaluation, nutrition, breeding principles, disease control, equipment, facilities to ensure scientifically based management decisions. Corequisite(s): AVS 1125 .

courses.title: Equine Enterprise Management
courses.description: Equine enterprise analysis with emphasis on capital acquisition, leasing, land acquisition, legal problems and labor problems.
courses.prerequisites: AVS 125 and AVS 125L, AVS 1125 and AVS 1125L , or instructor consent.

courses.title: Food and Agribusiness Marketing
courses.description: An introduction to the theory of marketing and its practical application to food and agricultural products and services. Evaluation of the marketing process, market research, marketing strategies and consumer behavior as applied to the agribusiness sector. Likewise, analysis of issues facing marketing institutions and formulation of solutions to address the current trends and developments in the California and American agribusiness industry. Develope skills for creating, evaluating and executing marketing decisions.

courses.title: Promotion and Advertising for Agribusiness
courses.description: An introduction to the principles of promotion and advertising as related to the marketing of agribusiness products and services. Functions of promotion and advertising as a core aspect of an Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC) mix. Evaluate strategies, tactics, execution and results of promotional efforts within the agribusiness sector, as well as its effects on consumers. Teams of students will work to create and develop a completely integrated promotional campaign that coordinates all aspects of promotion, including: Advertising, sales promotion, public relations, social media, and personal selling.

courses.title: Agribusiness Personnel Management
courses.description: Management-employee relations and theory; employee motivation; union and management relations; recruitment and selection; performance appraisal; communications; individual and group incentive systems; employee counseling; labor legislation; wage determination and salary systems; employment and unemployment. Case studies analyzed. Seminar discussions held, role playing emphasized, guest speakers.

courses.title: Equine Appraisal and Evaluation
courses.description: Principles of equine evaluation and appraisal. The student will perform an actual appraisal and be required to prepare an appraisal report.

courses.title: Foal Watch
courses.description: Basic equine breeding management, care of the pregnant mare, methods to detect impending foaling and parturition, difficulties that might occur during foaling, post foaling care and potential problems/disorder in foals.

courses.title: Equine Herd Health
courses.description: A study of the etiology, clinical signs, and control of infectious, nutritional and parasitic diseases of horses. 3 Lecture Corequisite(s): AVS 3365L .
courses.prerequisites: AVS 125 or AVS 1125 ; and AVS 125L or AVS 1125L .

courses.title: Equine Herd Health Laboratory
courses.description: Application of the fundamental aspects of preventative equine herd health diseases, veterinary care, nutrition, management, animal welfare and basic equine emergencies. 3 hour Laboratory Corequisite(s): AVS 3365 .
courses.prerequisites: AVS 125 or AVS 1125 ; and AVS 125L or AVS 1125L .

courses.title: Equine Exercise Physiology
courses.description: The basic and applied physiology of the exercising horse. Discussion of muscular respiratory, cardiovascular, nutritional, and osmoregulatory physiology. Includes gait analysis, lameness and pharmacology.
courses.prerequisites: AVS 350 or AVS 3350 ; and AVS 350L or AVS 3350L .

courses.title: Forage and Pasture Crops
courses.description: Establishment, management, and composition of irrigated and rangeland pastures adapted to southwestern conditions. Identification, botanical characteristics, and livestock utilization of major pasture species. Corequisite(s): PLT 2230L .

courses.title: Forage and Pasture Crops Laboratory
courses.description: Establishment, management, and composition of irrigated and rangeland pastures adapted to southwestern conditions. Identification, botanical characteristics, and livestock utilization of major pasture species. Corequisite(s): PLT 2230 .
